Questions, answered

CharmNest FAQ

How much are school-drop bracelets?

Confirmed monthly beaded and braided school-drop bracelets are $2 at eligible local school sales.

How much are custom school orders?

Local custom-color school orders are $3 when offered. Online custom products use higher pricing because they include additional design time, packaging, platform fees, and fulfillment.

Are monthly colors guaranteed?

No. CharmNest uses a live-drop model. Colors, charms, release dates, quantities, and availability are subject to change. Only confirmed drops are published.

Where do I see the latest drop?

The current confirmed drop appears on the School Drop page. The TikTok link will also show the newest update once it is connected.

Can I choose any charm?

Charm choices are limited to current approved inventory. Premium or oversized charms may change the final price.

Can I order a name bracelet?

Yes, through the online special-order form, subject to letter availability and the approved character limit.

What photos may appear publicly?

Hands and wrists are allowed. Faces, partial faces, reflections showing faces, school-identifying details, and private information are not allowed on public pages.

Is submitting the form the same as buying?

No. It creates a request. An adult-managed CharmNest contact must confirm availability, final price, timing, and payment instructions.
